title: Pocketwire Advance Delinquency Policy — Cure, Suspension, Write-Off and Reinstatement
content:
A Pocketwire Advance line that is past due moves, as its records require, back to active, on to suspended, and from suspended to reinstated or closed; the unpaid balance of a long past-due line is written off. Cure, suspension, reinstatement and the closure of a suspended line are made on the line by Pocketwire servicing.

## Cure

A past-due line returns to active as soon as no advance on it is past its grace period unpaid.

## Suspension

A line is suspended once it has been past due long enough: the suspension is recorded no earlier than the tier's suspension period in calendar days after the date the line became past due. The suspension period is counted in calendar days from the date the line became past due, as recorded in its past-due-since date, the day after being day 1, and suspension on the day the period is reached qualifies. The suspension date is recorded on the line.

## Write-off

The remaining principal and fees of each unpaid advance are written off once the line has been past due for the tier's write-off period in calendar days, counted the same way. A write-off ends collection by Pocketwire but the amount stays owed for a future line.

## Reinstatement or closure

A suspended line whose outstanding balance is 0.00 is reinstated on Pocketwire Advance Starter once the tier's reinstatement wait in calendar days has passed since the full repayment; a line with a write-off is closed instead of reinstated.

## Counting the suspension period (hypothetical, 30-day period)

| Day counted from the past-due-since date | Suspension |
|---|---|
| The past-due-since date itself | Not counted — day 0 |
| Day 29 | Too early |
| Day 30 | Qualifies — the day the period is reached |
| Day 31 | Qualifies |

The write-off period is counted the same way: on a tier with a write-off period of 120 calendar days, day 120 after the past-due-since date is the first day on which the write-off is reached.

## Line status moves

| From | To | When |
|---|---|---|
| past due | active | No advance on the line is past its grace period unpaid |
| past due | suspended | The suspension period is reached while the line is still past due |
| suspended | active, on Pocketwire Advance Starter | Outstanding balance 0.00 and the reinstatement wait has passed since the full repayment, with no write-off on the line |
| suspended | closed | A write-off on the line, or a balance repaid in full on a line that is not reinstated |
